VLA-Precision is an independently developed research codebase implementing
ACoB and ACoB-Stream.

The development of this project was informed by HIL-SERL and ConRFT. A limited
set of foundational utilities includes code adapted from these projects, with
modifications for VLA-Precision. HIL-SERL and ConRFT are licensed under the
Apache License 2.0.

VLA-Precision uses OpenPI as an external dependency. OpenPI is licensed under
the Apache License 2.0.
